fresh_corpus_source: Exp 248 GSM8K process-integrity reasoning rows joined to Exp 235 checked-in candidate traces; distinct from FoVer
methodology_note: Seeded balanced subsets mirror the frozen FoVer production score formula: fr11_session_memory + 0.9*tier0r_curry_howard + 0.1*tier0u_logical_consistency. tier0s_arithmetic_gap is scored and reported as one of the four FoVer-scoring verifier columns but has zero weight in the frozen production AUROC formula.
